data.name: SettingsLead
data.value: Account, this machine, and agent models. The project folder, members, and labels stay with the project.

data.name: ThisProjectLead
data.value: Folder, members, and labels for the open project.

data.name: AgentTemplatesLead
data.value: Saved ways to use your models. The model list stays with this account.

data.name: ModelNoteHint
data.value: For you. The launch command is unchanged.

data.name: ChatModelHint
data.value: Used by the app chat when a message does not name another model. Saving tells the running client to refresh OpenCode.

data.name: OpenCodeModelHint
data.value: Provider and model OpenCode already knows, like xai/grok-3. A saved connection can supply the key; otherwise sign in on the machine with opencode auth login.

data.name: OpenCodeConnectionsLead
data.value: These are OpenCode providers, not a Beacon provider. Saving queues a command: the client writes ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json and restarts opencode serve. The key is stored encrypted and is passed to the process as an environment variable.

data.name: OpenCodeApiKeyHint
data.value: Leave blank to keep the saved key. Built-in providers such as xai do not need a base URL.

data.name: OpenCodeConnectionSaved
data.value: Connection saved. The online client will apply it.

data.name: DangerZoneLead
data.value: A new agent is a token for the machine where beacon client runs. Turn on an authenticator before adding one.

data.name: AuthenticatorOn
data.value: Authenticator is on. Adding an agent asks for a code.

data.name: AuthenticatorOff
data.value: Authenticator is off. Add the key to an app such as Aegis or Authy, then confirm a code.

data.name: TaskKindsLead
data.value: A kind is how the work is done. The decision model plans and reviews. The worker model handles short slices, such as one screenshot.

data.name: TaskKindHint
data.value: The kind copies its phases onto this task.

data.name: DecisionModelHint
data.value: Plans the work and reads the slice reviews.

data.name: WorkerModelHint
data.value: Used when a phase is split into subtasks. Empty means the decision model.

data.name: BootstrapDescription
data.value: Create the initial administrator account. This can only be done once.

data.name: BootstrapSuccess
data.value: Admin account created. Save this password — it will not be shown again.

data.name: NoProjectAvailable
data.value: No project available. Create a project first.

data.name: LaunchCommandHint
data.value: Command line used to start the model backend.

data.name: LoadWithOthersHint
data.value: Keep this model loaded alongside others (llama-swap group, swap: false). Launch command must use ${PORT}.

data.name: ReportsEmpty
data.value: No reports yet. Generate a board snapshot.

data.name: OrphanWarning
data.value: Closed milestone still has {0} open task(s).

data.name: RecoverDescription
data.value: Enter the bootstrap token to reset the administrator password. The new password is shown once.

data.name: RecoverSuccess
data.value: Admin password reset. Save this password — it will not be shown again.

data.name: NoProjectsYet
data.value: No projects yet. Create one to get started.

data.name: ConfirmCloseHint
data.value: Optional. Falls back to the latest approve verdict note.

data.name: ForceCloseWarning
data.value: This closes the pipeline without a review verdict and cannot be undone.

data.name: NoDevicesYet
data.value: No devices yet. Add one and run beacon client with the token.

data.name: DeviceTokenOnce
data.value: Save this token. It is shown once. Run: beacon client --url {0} --token {1}

data.name: RevokeDeviceConfirm
data.value: Revoke this device? The client will stop receiving commands.

data.name: DeviceRequiredForBrowse
data.value: Connect a device to browse folders.

data.name: ApplyOnDeviceDone
data.value: OpenCode config applied on the device.

data.name: NoGgufFiles
data.value: No .gguf files in the device models directory.

data.name: WorkstationSaved
data.value: Workstation settings saved on the device.

data.name: InstallConfirm
data.value: Install {0} on the selected device via winget?

data.name: InstallQueued
data.value: Install command sent to the device.

data.name: NoBrief
data.value: No Goals or Definition of Done yet. Open Context to write those sections.

data.name: NoReadyTasks
data.value: No ready tasks. Move a card to Todo and an agent can call start_work.

data.name: DeleteLabelConfirm
data.value: Delete this label? Tasks keep their other fields.

data.name: ForgotDescription
data.value: Enter your email. If an account exists, a reset link will be sent.

data.name: ForgotSuccess
data.value: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way.

data.name: ResetSuccess
data.value: Password updated. You can log in now.

data.name: AlreadyHaveAccount
data.value: Already have an account? Log in, then reopen this link.

data.name: InviteSent
data.value: Invite created. Save this link — it is shown once.

data.name: LandingHeroTitle
data.value: Context that survives the next session.

data.name: LandingHeroLead
data.value: A control plane for mixed human + local-agent work. Beacon compiles the brief once so agents stop rediscovering what was already decided.

data.name: LandingProblemBody
data.value: Every new session, an agent greps around for decisions, constraints, and the files that matter. Beacon is the system of record that hands over a budgeted brief instead.

data.name: LandingHow1
data.value: Compile a budgeted brief from context, decisions, and constraints.

data.name: LandingHow2
data.value: Claim work on the board. Status, review notes, and pipeline stay in one place.

data.name: LandingHow3
data.value: Run the agent on your machine with beacon mcp and beacon client. Beacon never executes the turn.

data.name: LandingFeatureContext
data.value: Scoped briefs with a token budget. Never-drop security and definition of done.

data.name: LandingFeatureBoard
data.value: Board, backlog, and roadmap for mixed human and agent work.

data.name: LandingFeatureDecisions
data.value: Decisions carry consequences, so agents have a reason to respect them.

data.name: LandingFeatureAgents
data.value: Solo and pipeline models on hardware you control. llama-swap stays on the workstation.

data.name: LandingFeatureDevices
data.value: Outbound HTTPS from beacon client. The Web host does not read your disk.

data.name: LandingFeatureMcp
data.value: Local file tools and pipeline tools over stdio. HTTP MCP is not shipped.

data.name: LandingMockBrief
data.value:
## Goals Keep context current for mixed human + agent work.
## Non-goals No Beacon-hosted coding agent.

data.name: LandingFaq1Q
data.value: Does Beacon run the coding agent?

data.name: LandingFaq1A
data.value: No. Beacon relays and orchestrates. The agent process always runs on hardware you control.

data.name: LandingFaq2A
data.value: On your machine. beacon client talks outbound HTTPS. The Web host does not browse the working tree.

data.name: LandingFaq3A
data.value: Self-host is the v1 path. Hosted multi-tenant stays a later, gated phase.

data.name: LandingFaq4A
data.value: Open registration, or invite-only via AUTH_LOCAL_INVITE_ONLY. Invite from the open project on the dashboard; the link is shown once.

data.name: LandingFaq5Q
data.value: How do I reset a password?

data.name: LandingFaq5A
data.value: Use Forgot password. /recover is bootstrap-token admin break-glass, not user reset.

data.name: CreateProjectStepDevice
data.value: Pick the workstation running beacon client

data.name: CreateProjectStepFolder
data.value: Choose the folder on that machine

data.name: OrgNameHint
data.value: Leave blank to reuse the project name.

data.name: RuntimeDeviceHint
data.value: This is the PC where beacon.exe is running, not the browser.

data.name: NoDeviceForProject
data.value: No workstation yet. Add a device in Settings and start beacon.exe.

data.name: DeviceOfflineHint
data.value: This device is offline. Start artifacts/daemon/beacon.exe (or beacon client) and wait until it shows Connected.

data.name: BrowseOnDeviceHint
data.value: Browse lists folders on the selected workstation, not in this browser.

data.name: FolderOptionalHint
data.value: You can skip the folder now and attach it later on the dashboard.

data.name: InitializeOnDeviceHint
data.value: Writes .gitignore and opencode.json into that folder on the workstation.

data.name: ProjectFolderSaved
data.value: Project folder saved on this device.

data.name: HowToAddModel
data.value: Llama.cpp: put GGUF files in Settings → Local models directory, then Pick GGUF. Other types need a launch command. Save registers the model; Apply on device writes OpenCode config.

data.name: ModelSaveHint
data.value: llama-swap picks up the registry on the next client heartbeat. Apply on device is required for OpenCode to see the model. Neither starts a task.

data.name: LaunchCommandRequired
data.value: Launch command is required for this backend type.

data.name: PickGgufFirst
data.value: Pick a GGUF file (or paste a llama-server command with --port ${PORT}).

data.name: NeedProjectFolderForGguf
data.value: Attach a project folder on the dashboard so this page can scan GGUF files on the device.

data.name: NextStepTodo
data.value: Nothing runs by itself. Attach a folder on the dashboard, add a model in Settings, then Start Pipeline (manual stages) or complete the task via MCP finish_work.

data.name: NextStepCreateSubtask
data.value: Create a subtask, then Start Actor Session. Launch Session only marks the session Active in Beacon — it does not start OpenCode.

data.name: LaunchSessionHint
data.value: Launch Session updates status in the database. It does not spawn OpenCode.

data.name: NoAgentSessionsHint
data.value: No active pipeline sessions. Models do not start tasks; open a task and Start Pipeline, or use MCP.

data.name: StartClientHint
data.value: Start beacon.exe on this PC to see CPU, RAM, and GPU.

data.name: ChatEmptyHint
data.value: Start a chat. OpenCode runs on the workstation via beacon client.

data.name: ChatNeedsFolder
data.value: Attach a project folder on the dashboard before chatting.

data.name: ChatNeedsClient
data.value: Start beacon client on this workstation, then open chat again.
